# Yemen

> [!summary] Data available
> Moderate QA coverage and little else: [[ArabCulture]] has 57 food items, 36 of them Yemen-specific (a high share), and [[WorldCuisines]] has 18 dishes (4 Yemeni-only). There is no recipe corpus or FCT; plants come from [[CMAUP]] (56) and [[KNApSAcK Family]].

## Foods & dishes
- [[ArabCulture]]: 273 items, 57 food (36 Yemen-specific) + 7 food-adjacent. The best Yemeni food-knowledge source.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 18 dishes, 4 Yemen-specific.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 2 dishes (11 rows), ingredients without amounts.
- [[Saudi Food Composition Tables]] includes a Yemeni-origin dish in the Makkah chapter (Mantu, "Yemeni yaghmish").
- [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: Yemen claimed; counts unknown.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Yemeni FCT. Proxies: [[Saudi Food Composition Tables]] (southern regions Jazan, Najran, Aseer) and [[USDA FoodData Central]]. Candidate: [[EMFID (Eastern Mediterranean Food Information Data Bank)|EMFID]].

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[CMAUP]]: 56 plants (55 scraped). [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 13 records (9 edible / 4 medicinal). [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 5 records.
- For compound → effect chains use the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions); [[FooDB]] has **no nigella/black seed, sumac, camel milk, za'atar, ghee or labneh**.

## Gaps
- No recipes with amounts, no composition data, no BLEnD file, no traditional-medicine data.
